Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/942)
I am glad you see your way to publishing these books on the half profit system I send the [Two Guardians](/book/13) and [Henrietta’s Wish](/book/11) shall follow, as soon as we can supply the first two pages which are gone from the only copy I can find

Yours truly

C M Yonge
